entry.name: decide
entry.description: Outputs random and messages. The output sequence depends on the seed value to determine the sequence of values.

arguments.name: seed
arguments.description: Sets a "seed" value to cause a specific (reproducible) sequence of pseudo-randomandoutputs to occur. If there is no argument, the time elapsed since system startup (an unpredictable value) is used as the seed, ensuring an unpredictable sequence for output.
